The Black Dahlia Murder is an American metal band from Waterford, Michigan, formed in 2001. The band's name is derived from the unsolved Black Dahlia murder of 1947, which is said to have taken place in Los Angeles. The band's musical style is a mixture of traditional metal, death metal, and melodic death metal. The group has released eight full-length albums and two EPs.
